questionnaire_answers.question: Hi! I'm here to conduct your pre-surgery consultation. We'll go through some questions about your medical history and current health — it should only take a few minutes. Feel free to ask me anything along the way. Just let me know when you're ready to begin.
What is your name?
How old are you?
How tall are you in centimeters?
How much do you weigh in kilograms?
What is your biological gender?
Have you ever had anesthesia before?
Did you experience any problems with it?
Has anyone in your family ever had an adverse reaction to anesthesia?
Has a doctor ever told you that you were difficult to intubate or that you have a difficult airway?
Do you have sleep apnea or use a CPAP machine at night?
Do you have any loose teeth, dentures, or dental implants?
Do you have any allergies to medications, latex, or anesthesia drugs?
Do you take any daily prescription medications?
Could you list them for me?
Do you take blood thinners such as aspirin, warfarin, Eliquis, or Xarelto?
Do you take any non-prescription medications, supplements, or herbal remedies — including things like fish oil, vitamins, or over-the-counter painkillers?
Could you list what you're taking?
Do you have any heart conditions, chest pain, or a history of heart surgery or stents?
Do you have asthma, COPD, or any other breathing problems?
Do you get short of breath when walking on flat ground or climbing stairs?
Do you experience acid reflux or heartburn, or take any medication for it?
Have you had any recent infections, fever, or major health changes in the last few weeks?
Do you smoke or use any nicotine products?
How much alcohol do you consume on a weekly basis?
Do you use any recreational or illicit drugs?
Are you feeling anxious or worried about the anesthesia or the operation?
Is there anything else about your health or previous surgeries that you think the anesthesiologist should know?
Do you have any additional questions or concerns that you would like to discuss?
